newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star off on same-store sales worry.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star off on same-store sales worry.

text.p: Lone Star Steakhouse & Saloon Inc said Tuesday that weakness in its share price was due to concern over the restaurant chain's same-store sales, which were off 5.1 percent in the first quarter.
"We told people that they (same-store sales) are not getting any better," said John White, chief financial officer.
He declined to comment on whether same-store sales had declined further since the first quarter.
He said the company would give an update in a mid-quarter conference call with analysts scheduled for tomorrow.
Raymond James analyst Michael Fineman said he expected same-store sales to continue to be down about five percent.
He said the planned conference call raised concern among investors who wondered what Lone Star might announce.
White said the conference call was expected to be only a "mid-quarter update," with no change in guidance to analysts or any major announcement.
